settings_help.source: (str) - Where Mask Generation keeps the fields Measure reads. 'ome-zarr' stores each field in fov.ome.zarr in the project folder: the acquired channels in their own dtype (no stack/ folder) and the masks of every stage as label images (no masks/ folder); no merged/*.npy is written. 'npy' writes stack/*.npy and merged/*.npy as before; 'tiff' adds merged_tiff/<field>.tif and <field>_<object>_mask.tif. Timelapse frames go on a t axis, z slices on a z axis (projected when read). Older layouts (stack/, masks/, merged/*.npy, images/<plate>.ome.zarr) still read. Default 'ome-zarr'. Alpha.

(bool) - Keep the run's working masks/ folders after every field is merged. Off by default: they are removed once each field is committed to fov.ome.zarr (or merged/ for 'npy' runs), which holds the channels and every mask. With fov.ome.zarr no stack/ or masks/ folder is written: the channels and the masks of every stage go straight into the field (the small run records to fov.ome.zarr/.spacr_mask_run); kept, those labels are reused by a rerun, otherwise a rerun segments again. Older projects' stack/ folders are still read, and kept or removed by this setting as before.

(bool) - What happens to the original images once their pixels are in fov.ome.zarr. On (the default): after a field is committed and every channel plane is verified byte for byte against its original, its originals are moved into orig/ in the project folder. Off: they are deleted after that check, which cannot be undone; each stored z slice is checked against its own file, and a field whose channels had different z slices is stored projected, so its originals go to orig/. A run cut short never loses an image. With 'npy' or 'tiff' runs, orig/ is deleted at the end only when off. Default True.

(bool) - The older switch for the original images. Off acts as keep_original_images off: with fov.ome.zarr each original is deleted only after its field is committed and verified there; with 'npy' or 'tiff' runs the raw images are deleted once they are in stack/, as before, which is not reversible. Use keep_original_images instead. Default True.

(bool) - When True, spaCR requires the array to contain an explicit z dimension and raises an error instead of inferring the axis; this enables z_segmentation_mode, anisotropy and stitch_threshold. Standard ingestion stores every z slice in fov.ome.zarr and segments its maximum-intensity projection, computed on read, so it segments in 2-D; supply volumetric arrays directly to spacr.zstack instead. When False, no z-stack code runs and masks match a two-dimensional run. Default False.
